content.value: A mixture of gases consists of 3.6 kg of N2 and 5.8 kg of $C O _ { 2 }$ at a pressure of 300 kPa and 14 temperature of 21°C. Calculate- (i) the mass fraction and mole fraction of each constituent, (ii) the equivalent molecular weight of the mixture and (iii) the Cp and Cv of the mixture. Consider γ for $\mathbf { C O } _ { 2 }$ and ${ \bf N } _ { 2 }$ are 1.29 and 1.39 respectively.
